note: Sampling results printed in located City records, transcribed with the value, unit, medium and location as the document prints them. Each row quotes a registered claim at its Bates page. Units are not converted: percent asbestos in bulk dust, structures per square millimetre on an air filter and parts per billion of a gas measure different things.
boundary: This short list holds the results located so far. A full sampling dataset would hold every result. The list makes no health finding and no comparison with any standard beyond what the document itself states.
